+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from enum import StrEnum
+from uuid import UUID, uuid4
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
+
+
+class ConversationState(StrEnum):
+    READY = "ready"
+    CLOSED = "closed"
+
+
+class Intent(StrEnum):
+    FAQ = "faq"
+    MAINTENANCE = "maintenance"
+    UNKNOWN = "unknown"
+
+
+class IncidentType(StrEnum):
+    FIRE_OR_SMOKE = "fire_or_smoke"
+    GAS_SMELL = "gas_smell"
+    ACTIVE_FLOODING = "active_flooding"
+    ELEVATOR_ENTRAPMENT = "elevator_entrapment"
+    ACCESS_FAILURE = "access_failure"
+    HVAC = "hvac"
+    COSMETIC = "cosmetic"
+    UNKNOWN = "unknown"
+
+
+class Priority(StrEnum):
+    EMERGENCY = "emergency"
+    URGENT = "urgent"
+    ROUTINE = "routine"
+
+
+class IncidentReport(BaseModel):
+    incident_type: IncidentType
+    description: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=2_000)
+    location: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=300)
+    water_active: bool | None = None
+    source_known: bool | None = None
+    resident_safe: bool | None = None
+
+
+class EmergencyDecision(BaseModel):
+    incident_type: IncidentType
+    priority: Priority
+    instructions: list[str]
+    dispatch_vendor: bool
+    transfer_to_on_call: bool
+    create_work_order: bool
+
+
+class TenantContext(BaseModel):
+    management_company_id: UUID
+    community_id: UUID
+
+
+class Community(TenantContext):
+    name: str
+    office_phone: str
+    on_call_phone: str
+    faqs: dict[str, str]
+
+
+class Resident(TenantContext):
+    id: UUID
+    first_name: str
+    phone: str
+    unit: str
+
+
+class WorkOrder(TenantContext):
+    id: UUID = Field(default_factory=uuid4)
+    conversation_id: UUID
+    resident_id: UUID | None = None
+    incident_type: IncidentType
+    priority: Priority
+    description: str
+    status: str = "open"
+    created_at: datetime = Field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(UTC))
+
+
+class ActionType(StrEnum):
+    WORK_ORDER_CREATED = "work_order_created"
+    SMS_QUEUED = "sms_queued"
+    TRANSFER_REQUESTED = "transfer_requested"
+
+
+class WorkflowAction(BaseModel):
+    type: ActionType
+    detail: str
+    reference_id: UUID | None = None
+

```diff
+from hoa_voice_agent.domain.models import (
+    EmergencyDecision,
+    IncidentReport,
+    IncidentType,
+    Priority,
+)
+
+
+class EmergencyPolicyEngine:
+    """Deterministic safety policy. Model output may supply facts, never the decision."""
+
+    def decide(self, report: IncidentReport) -> EmergencyDecision:
+        match report.incident_type:
+            case IncidentType.FIRE_OR_SMOKE:
+                return EmergencyDecision(
+                    incident_type=report.incident_type,
+                    priority=Priority.EMERGENCY,
+                    instructions=[
+                        "Leave the building if it is safe to do so.",
+                        "Call 911 from a safe location.",
+                    ],
+                    dispatch_vendor=False,
+                    transfer_to_on_call=True,
+                    create_work_order=True,
+                )
+            case IncidentType.GAS_SMELL:
+                return EmergencyDecision(
+                    incident_type=report.incident_type,
+                    priority=Priority.EMERGENCY,
+                    instructions=[
+                        "Leave the area without operating switches or appliances.",
+                        "Call 911 or the gas utility from a safe location.",
+                    ],
+                    dispatch_vendor=False,
+                    transfer_to_on_call=True,
+                    create_work_order=True,
+                )
+            case IncidentType.ELEVATOR_ENTRAPMENT:
+                return EmergencyDecision(
+                    incident_type=report.incident_type,
+                    priority=Priority.EMERGENCY,
+                    instructions=[
+                        "Stay in the elevator and use its emergency call button.",
+                        "Call 911 if anyone needs immediate medical help.",
+                    ],
+                    dispatch_vendor=True,
+                    transfer_to_on_call=True,
+                    create_work_order=True,
+                )
+            case IncidentType.ACTIVE_FLOODING:
+                active = report.water_active is not False
+                return EmergencyDecision(
+                    incident_type=report.incident_type,
+                    priority=Priority.EMERGENCY if active else Priority.URGENT,
+                    instructions=[
+                        "Avoid standing water near electrical outlets or equipment.",
+                        "If it is safe, move belongings away from the water.",
+                    ],
+                    dispatch_vendor=True,
+                    transfer_to_on_call=active,
+                    create_work_order=True,
+                )
+            case IncidentType.ACCESS_FAILURE:
+                return EmergencyDecision(
+                    incident_type=report.incident_type,
+                    priority=Priority.URGENT,
+                    instructions=["Stay in a safe, well-lit location while help is arranged."],
+                    dispatch_vendor=True,
+                    transfer_to_on_call=True,
+                    create_work_order=True,
+                )
+            case IncidentType.HVAC:
+                return EmergencyDecision(
+                    incident_type=report.incident_type,
+                    priority=Priority.URGENT,
+                    instructions=[],
+                    dispatch_vendor=True,
+                    transfer_to_on_call=False,
+                    create_work_order=True,
+                )
+            case IncidentType.COSMETIC | IncidentType.UNKNOWN:
+                return EmergencyDecision(
+                    incident_type=report.incident_type,
+                    priority=Priority.ROUTINE,
+                    instructions=[],
+                    dispatch_vendor=False,
+                    transfer_to_on_call=False,
+                    create_work_order=True,
+                )
+

```diff
+import re
+
+from hoa_voice_agent.domain.models import IncidentReport, IncidentType
+
+
+class RuleBasedIncidentExtractor:
+    """Temporary Phase 1 extractor; replace with schema-constrained LLM output."""
+
+    _rules: tuple[tuple[IncidentType, tuple[str, ...]], ...] = (
+        (IncidentType.FIRE_OR_SMOKE, ("fire", "smoke", "burning")),
+        (IncidentType.GAS_SMELL, ("gas smell", "smell gas", "natural gas")),
+        (
+            IncidentType.ELEVATOR_ENTRAPMENT,
+            ("stuck in the elevator", "trapped in the elevator", "elevator trapped"),
+        ),
+        (
+            IncidentType.ACTIVE_FLOODING,
+            ("flood", "leak", "water coming", "burst pipe", "overflow"),
+        ),
+        (
+            IncidentType.ACCESS_FAILURE,
+            ("locked out", "gate won't open", "gate does not open", "key fob"),
+        ),
+        (
+            IncidentType.HVAC,
+            ("no heat", "no air", "air conditioning", "heater", "hvac", "ac is"),
+        ),
+        (
+            IncidentType.COSMETIC,
+            ("paint", "scratch", "stain", "cosmetic", "crack in"),
+        ),
+    )
+
+    def extract(self, description: str) -> IncidentReport:
+        normalized = " ".join(description.lower().split())
+        incident_type = IncidentType.UNKNOWN
+        for candidate, phrases in self._rules:
+            if any(phrase in normalized for phrase in phrases):
+                incident_type = candidate
+                break
+
+        location_match = re.search(
+            r"\b(?:at|in|near)\s+((?:building|unit|floor|hallway|garage|lobby)[^,.!?]*)",
+            description,
+            flags=re.IGNORECASE,
+        )
+        water_active = None
+        if incident_type == IncidentType.ACTIVE_FLOODING:
+            water_active = not any(
+                phrase in normalized
+                for phrase in ("stopped", "not active", "was leaking", "no longer leaking")
+            )
+
+        return IncidentReport(
+            incident_type=incident_type,
+            description=description,
+            location=location_match.group(1).strip() if location_match else None,
+            water_active=water_active,
+        )
+
```

+from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
+
+from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import (
+    AsyncEngine,
+    AsyncSession,
+    async_sessionmaker,
+    create_async_engine,
+)
+from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase
+
+
+class Base(DeclarativeBase):
+    pass
+
+
+class Database:
+    def __init__(self, url: str) -> None:
+        self.engine: AsyncEngine = create_async_engine(url, pool_pre_ping=True)
+        self.session_factory = async_sessionmaker(
+            self.engine,
+            expire_on_commit=False,
+            class_=AsyncSession,
+        )
+
+    async def create_schema(self) -> None:
+        async with self.engine.begin() as connection:
+            await connection.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)
+
+    async def sessions(self) -> AsyncIterator[AsyncSession]:
+        async with self.session_factory() as session:
+            yield session
+
+    async def dispose(self) -> None:
+        await self.engine.dispose()
+
```

```diff
+from uuid import UUID
+
+from sqlalchemy import select
+from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
+
+from hoa_voice_agent.domain.models import (
+    ConversationState,
+    IncidentType,
+    Priority,
+    WorkOrder,
+)
+from hoa_voice_agent.persistence.tables import ConversationRecord, WorkOrderRecord
+
+
+class ConversationRepository:
+    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession) -> None:
+        self.session = session
+
+    async def create(
+        self,
+        *,
+        management_company_id: UUID,
+        community_id: UUID,
+        caller_phone: str,
+        resident_id: UUID | None,
+    ) -> ConversationRecord:
+        record = ConversationRecord(
+            management_company_id=management_company_id,
+            community_id=community_id,
+            resident_id=resident_id,
+            caller_phone=caller_phone,
+            state=ConversationState.READY.value,
+        )
+        self.session.add(record)
+        await self.session.commit()
+        await self.session.refresh(record)
+        return record
+
+    async def get(self, conversation_id: UUID) -> ConversationRecord | None:
+        return await self.session.get(ConversationRecord, conversation_id)
+
+
+class WorkOrderRepository:
+    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession) -> None:
+        self.session = session
+
+    async def create(self, work_order: WorkOrder) -> WorkOrder:
+        record = WorkOrderRecord(
+            id=work_order.id,
+            conversation_id=work_order.conversation_id,
+            management_company_id=work_order.management_company_id,
+            community_id=work_order.community_id,
+            resident_id=work_order.resident_id,
+            incident_type=work_order.incident_type.value,
+            priority=work_order.priority.value,
+            description=work_order.description,
+            status=work_order.status,
+            created_at=work_order.created_at,
+        )
+        self.session.add(record)
+        await self.session.commit()
+        return work_order
+
+    async def list_for_conversation(self, conversation_id: UUID) -> list[WorkOrder]:
+        result = await self.session.scalars(
+            select(WorkOrderRecord)
+            .where(WorkOrderRecord.conversation_id == conversation_id)
+            .order_by(WorkOrderRecord.created_at)
+        )
+        return [
+            WorkOrder(
+                id=row.id,
+                conversation_id=row.conversation_id,
+                management_company_id=row.management_company_id,
+                community_id=row.community_id,
+                resident_id=row.resident_id,
+                incident_type=IncidentType(row.incident_type),
+                priority=Priority(row.priority),
+                description=row.description,
+                status=row.status,
+                created_at=row.created_at,
+            )
+            for row in result
+        ]
+

```diff
+import re
+from uuid import UUID
+
+from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
+
+from hoa_voice_agent.adapters.protocols import (
+    CallControlAdapter,
+    CommunityManagementAdapter,
+    MessagingAdapter,
+)
+from hoa_voice_agent.api_models import (
+    ConversationTurnResponse,
+    StartConversationResponse,
+)
+from hoa_voice_agent.domain.emergency_policy import EmergencyPolicyEngine
+from hoa_voice_agent.domain.incident_extractor import RuleBasedIncidentExtractor
+from hoa_voice_agent.domain.models import (
+    ActionType,
+    ConversationState,
+    Intent,
+    WorkflowAction,
+    WorkOrder,
+)
+from hoa_voice_agent.persistence.repository import (
+    ConversationRepository,
+    WorkOrderRepository,
+)
+
+
+class ConversationNotFoundError(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+class CommunityNotFoundError(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+class ConversationService:
+    _maintenance_terms = {
+        "broken",
+        "damage",
+        "fire",
+        "flood",
+        "gas",
+        "heat",
+        "hvac",
+        "leak",
+        "maintenance",
+        "repair",
+        "smoke",
+        "stuck",
+        "water",
+        "locked out",
+        "won't open",
+        "does not work",
+    }
+    _stop_words = {
+        "a",
+        "an",
+        "are",
+        "can",
+        "do",
+        "does",
+        "for",
+        "how",
+        "i",
+        "is",
+        "me",
+        "my",
+        "of",
+        "the",
+        "what",
+        "when",
+        "where",
+        "you",
+    }
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        session: AsyncSession,
+        community_management: CommunityManagementAdapter,
+        messaging: MessagingAdapter,
+        call_control: CallControlAdapter,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.conversations = ConversationRepository(session)
+        self.work_orders = WorkOrderRepository(session)
+        self.community_management = community_management
+        self.messaging = messaging
+        self.call_control = call_control
+        self.extractor = RuleBasedIncidentExtractor()
+        self.policy = EmergencyPolicyEngine()
+
+    async def start(self, caller_phone: str, community_id: UUID) -> StartConversationResponse:
+        community = await self.community_management.get_community(community_id)
+        if community is None:
+            raise CommunityNotFoundError
+
+        resident = await self.community_management.find_resident(caller_phone)
+        conversation = await self.conversations.create(
+            management_company_id=community.management_company_id,
+            community_id=community.community_id,
+            caller_phone=caller_phone,
+            resident_id=resident.id if resident else None,
+        )
+        greeting = (
+            f"Hi {resident.first_name}, thank you for calling {community.name}. "
+            "How can I help?"
+            if resident
+            else f"Thank you for calling {community.name}. How can I help?"
+        )
+        return StartConversationResponse(
+            conversation_id=conversation.id,
+            community_id=conversation.community_id,
+            resident_id=conversation.resident_id,
+            state=ConversationState(conversation.state),
+            say=greeting,
+        )
+
+    async def handle_turn(
+        self,
+        conversation_id: UUID,
+        text: str,
+    ) -> ConversationTurnResponse:
+        conversation = await self.conversations.get(conversation_id)
+        if conversation is None:
+            raise ConversationNotFoundError
+
+        community = await self.community_management.get_community(conversation.community_id)
+        if community is None:
+            raise CommunityNotFoundError
+
+        normalized = " ".join(text.lower().split())
+        if self._looks_like_maintenance(normalized):
+            return await self._handle_maintenance(conversation, community, text)
+
+        faq_answer = self._find_faq_answer(normalized, community.faqs)
+        if faq_answer:
+            return ConversationTurnResponse(
+                conversation_id=conversation.id,
+                intent=Intent.FAQ,
+                say=faq_answer,
+            )
+
+        return ConversationTurnResponse(
+            conversation_id=conversation.id,
+            intent=Intent.UNKNOWN,
+            say=(
+                "I can help with community questions or report a maintenance issue. "
+                "Which of those do you need?"
+            ),
+        )
+
+    async def _handle_maintenance(
+        self,
+        conversation,
+        community,
+        text: str,
+    ) -> ConversationTurnResponse:
+        report = self.extractor.extract(text)
+        decision = self.policy.decide(report)
+        work_order = WorkOrder(
+            conversation_id=conversation.id,
+            management_company_id=conversation.management_company_id,
+            community_id=conversation.community_id,
+            resident_id=conversation.resident_id,
+            incident_type=report.incident_type,
+            priority=decision.priority,
+            description=report.description,
+        )
+        await self.community_management.create_work_order(work_order)
+        await self.work_orders.create(work_order)
+
+        actions = [
+            WorkflowAction(
+                type=ActionType.WORK_ORDER_CREATED,
+                detail=f"{decision.priority.value} work order created",
+                reference_id=work_order.id,
+            )
+        ]
+
+        sms_reference = await self.messaging.send_sms(
+            conversation.caller_phone,
+            f"{community.name}: work order {work_order.id} was created.",
+        )
+        actions.append(
+            WorkflowAction(
+                type=ActionType.SMS_QUEUED,
+                detail=sms_reference,
+                reference_id=work_order.id,
+            )
+        )
+
+        if decision.transfer_to_on_call:
+            transfer_reference = await self.call_control.transfer_to_on_call(
+                conversation.id,
+                community.on_call_phone,
+            )
+            actions.append(
+                WorkflowAction(
+                    type=ActionType.TRANSFER_REQUESTED,
+                    detail=transfer_reference,
+                    reference_id=work_order.id,
+                )
+            )
+
+        spoken_parts = list(decision.instructions)
+        spoken_parts.append("I created a work order and sent a confirmation by text.")
+        if decision.transfer_to_on_call:
+            spoken_parts.append("I am connecting you to the on-call manager now.")
+
+        return ConversationTurnResponse(
+            conversation_id=conversation.id,
+            intent=Intent.MAINTENANCE,
+            say=" ".join(spoken_parts),
+            actions=actions,
+            decision=decision,
+            work_order=work_order,
+        )
+
+    def _looks_like_maintenance(self, text: str) -> bool:
+        return any(term in text for term in self._maintenance_terms)
+
+    def _find_faq_answer(self, text: str, faqs: dict[str, str]) -> str | None:
+        for question, answer in faqs.items():
+            if question in text:
+                return answer
+
+        query_tokens = self._meaningful_tokens(text)
+        best_answer: str | None = None
+        best_score = 0
+        for question, answer in faqs.items():
+            score = len(query_tokens & self._meaningful_tokens(question))
+            if score > best_score:
+                best_answer = answer
+                best_score = score
+        return best_answer if best_score >= 1 else None
+
+    def _meaningful_tokens(self, text: str) -> set[str]:
+        tokens = set(re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", text.lower()))
+        return tokens - self._stop_words
+

+from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
+from typing import Annotated
+from uuid import UUID
+
+from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, HTTPException, Request, status
+from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
+
+from hoa_voice_agent.adapters.fake import (
+    FakeCallControlAdapter,
+    FakeCommunityManagementAdapter,
+    FakeMessagingAdapter,
+)
+from hoa_voice_agent.api_models import (
+    ConversationTurnRequest,
+    ConversationTurnResponse,
+    HealthResponse,
+    StartConversationRequest,
+    StartConversationResponse,
+)
+from hoa_voice_agent.config import Settings, get_settings
+from hoa_voice_agent.domain.models import WorkOrder
+from hoa_voice_agent.persistence import tables as _tables  # noqa: F401
+from hoa_voice_agent.persistence.database import Database
+from hoa_voice_agent.persistence.repository import WorkOrderRepository
+from hoa_voice_agent.services.conversation import (
+    CommunityNotFoundError,
+    ConversationNotFoundError,
+    ConversationService,
+)
+
+
+def create_app(settings: Settings | None = None) -> FastAPI:
+    app_settings = settings or get_settings()
+    database = Database(app_settings.database_url)
+
+    @asynccontextmanager
+    async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
+        app.state.database = database
+        app.state.community_management = FakeCommunityManagementAdapter()
+        app.state.messaging = FakeMessagingAdapter()
+        app.state.call_control = FakeCallControlAdapter()
+        await database.create_schema()
+        yield
+        await database.dispose()
+
+    app = FastAPI(
+        title=app_settings.app_name,
+        version="0.1.0",
+        lifespan=lifespan,
+    )
+
+    async def get_session(request: Request):
+        async for session in request.app.state.database.sessions():
+            yield session
+
+    async def get_service(
+        request: Request,
+        session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_session)],
+    ) -> ConversationService:
+        return ConversationService(
+            session=session,
+            community_management=request.app.state.community_management,
+            messaging=request.app.state.messaging,
+            call_control=request.app.state.call_control,
+        )
+
+    @app.get("/health", response_model=HealthResponse)
+    async def health() -> HealthResponse:
+        return HealthResponse(status="ok", service=app_settings.app_name)
+
+    @app.post(
+        "/api/v1/conversations",
+        response_model=StartConversationResponse,
+        status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
+    )
+    async def start_conversation(
+        body: StartConversationRequest,
+        service: Annotated[ConversationService, Depends(get_service)],
+    ) -> StartConversationResponse:
+        try:
+            return await service.start(body.caller_phone, body.community_id)
+        except CommunityNotFoundError as exc:
+            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Community not found") from exc
+
+    @app.post(
+        "/api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/turns",
+        response_model=ConversationTurnResponse,
+    )
+    async def submit_turn(
+        conversation_id: UUID,
+        body: ConversationTurnRequest,
+        service: Annotated[ConversationService, Depends(get_service)],
+    ) -> ConversationTurnResponse:
+        try:
+            return await service.handle_turn(conversation_id, body.text)
+        except ConversationNotFoundError as exc:
+            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Conversation not found") from exc
+        except CommunityNotFoundError as exc:
+            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Community not found") from exc
+
+    @app.get(
+        "/api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/work-orders",
+        response_model=list[WorkOrder],
+    )
+    async def list_work_orders(
+        conversation_id: UUID,
+        session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_session)],
+    ) -> list[WorkOrder]:
+        return await WorkOrderRepository(session).list_for_conversation(conversation_id)
+
+    return app
+
+
+app = create_app()
+

+      speechSynthesis.cancel();
+      const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
+      utterance.rate = 1.04;
+      speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
+    }
+
+    async function start() {
+      addMessage("Starting a simulated resident call…", "system");
+      const response = await fetch("/api/v1/conversations", {
+        method: "POST",
+        headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        body: JSON.stringify({caller_phone: "+15550101111"})
+      });
+      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Could not start the conversation");
+      const data = await response.json();
+      conversationId = data.conversation_id;
+      addMessage(data.say, "agent");
+      input.disabled = false;
+      send.disabled = false;
+      input.focus();
+      speak(data.say);
+    }
+
+    async function submitTurn(text) {
+      addMessage(text, "resident");
+      input.value = "";
+      input.disabled = true;
+      send.disabled = true;
+      const response = await fetch(`/api/v1/conversations/${conversationId}/turns`, {
+        method: "POST",
+        headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        body: JSON.stringify({text})
+      });
+      const data = await response.json();
+      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.detail || "Turn failed");
+      addMessage(data.say, "agent");
+      if (data.actions.length) {
+        addMessage(data.actions.map(action => action.type).join(" · "), "system");
+      }
+      speak(data.say);
+      input.disabled = false;
+      send.disabled = false;
+      input.focus();
+    }
+
+    form.addEventListener("submit", async event => {
+      event.preventDefault();
+      const text = input.value.trim();
+      if (!text) return;
+      try {
+        await submitTurn(text);
+      } catch (error) {
+        addMessage(error.message, "system");
+        input.disabled = false;
+        send.disabled = false;
+      }
+    });
+
+    const SpeechRecognition = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
+    if (SpeechRecognition) {
+      const recognition = new SpeechRecognition();
+      recognition.lang = "en-US";
+      recognition.interimResults = false;
+      recognition.addEventListener("start", () => mic.classList.add("listening"));
+      recognition.addEventListener("end", () => mic.classList.remove("listening"));
+      recognition.addEventListener("result", event => {
+        input.value = event.results[0][0].transcript;
+        form.requestSubmit();
+      });
+      mic.addEventListener("click", () => recognition.start());
+    } else {
+      mic.disabled = true;
+      mic.title = "Speech recognition is not available in this browser";
+    }
+
+    start().catch(error => addMessage(error.message, "system"));
+  </script>
+</body>
+</html>

+import pytest
+
+from hoa_voice_agent.domain.emergency_policy import EmergencyPolicyEngine
+from hoa_voice_agent.domain.models import IncidentReport, IncidentType, Priority
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("incident_type", "priority", "transfer"),
+    [
+        (IncidentType.FIRE_OR_SMOKE, Priority.EMERGENCY, True),
+        (IncidentType.GAS_SMELL, Priority.EMERGENCY, True),
+        (IncidentType.ELEVATOR_ENTRAPMENT, Priority.EMERGENCY, True),
+        (IncidentType.ACCESS_FAILURE, Priority.URGENT, True),
+        (IncidentType.HVAC, Priority.URGENT, False),
+        (IncidentType.COSMETIC, Priority.ROUTINE, False),
+        (IncidentType.UNKNOWN, Priority.ROUTINE, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_policy_decisions_are_deterministic(
+    incident_type: IncidentType,
+    priority: Priority,
+    transfer: bool,
+) -> None:
+    report = IncidentReport(incident_type=incident_type, description="Test incident")
+
+    decision = EmergencyPolicyEngine().decide(report)
+
+    assert decision.priority == priority
+    assert decision.transfer_to_on_call is transfer
+    assert decision.create_work_order is True
+
+
+def test_active_flooding_is_emergency_while_water_is_running() -> None:
+    report = IncidentReport(
+        incident_type=IncidentType.ACTIVE_FLOODING,
+        description="Water is leaking from the ceiling",
+        water_active=True,
+    )
+
+    decision = EmergencyPolicyEngine().decide(report)
+
+    assert decision.priority == Priority.EMERGENCY
+    assert decision.dispatch_vendor is True
+    assert decision.transfer_to_on_call is True
+
+
+def test_stopped_leak_is_urgent_but_does_not_force_transfer() -> None:
+    report = IncidentReport(
+        incident_type=IncidentType.ACTIVE_FLOODING,
+        description="The pipe was leaking but it stopped",
+        water_active=False,
+    )
+
+    decision = EmergencyPolicyEngine().decide(report)
+
+    assert decision.priority == Priority.URGENT
+    assert decision.transfer_to_on_call is False
+

+from pathlib import Path
+
+import httpx
+import pytest
+
+from hoa_voice_agent.api import create_app
+from hoa_voice_agent.config import Settings
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+async def client(tmp_path: Path):
+    settings = Settings(
+        app_env="test",
+        database_url=f"sqlite+aiosqlite:///{tmp_path / 'test.db'}",
+    )
+    app = create_app(settings)
+    async with app.router.lifespan_context(app):
+        transport = httpx.ASGITransport(app=app)
+        async with httpx.AsyncClient(transport=transport, base_url="http://test") as client:
+            yield client
+
+
+async def start_conversation(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> str:
+    response = await client.post(
+        "/api/v1/conversations",
+        json={"caller_phone": "+15550101111"},
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 201
+    return response.json()["conversation_id"]
+
+
+async def test_health(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
+    response = await client.get("/health")
+
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json()["status"] == "ok"
+
+
+async def test_known_resident_gets_personalized_greeting(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
+    response = await client.post(
+        "/api/v1/conversations",
+        json={"caller_phone": "+15550101111"},
+    )
+
+    assert response.status_code == 201
+    assert response.json()["say"].startswith("Hi Alex")
+    assert response.json()["resident_id"] is not None
+
+
+async def test_faq_turn_returns_community_answer(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
+    conversation_id = await start_conversation(client)
+
+    response = await client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/turns",
+        json={"text": "What time does the pool close?"},
+    )
+
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    payload = response.json()
+    assert payload["intent"] == "faq"
+    assert "9 PM" in payload["say"]
+    assert payload["actions"] == []
+
+
+async def test_active_leak_creates_work_order_sms_and_transfer(
+    client: httpx.AsyncClient,
+) -> None:
+    conversation_id = await start_conversation(client)
+
+    response = await client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/turns",
+        json={"text": "Water is leaking from the ceiling in Building A hallway."},
+    )
+
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    payload = response.json()
+    assert payload["intent"] == "maintenance"
+    assert payload["decision"]["priority"] == "emergency"
+    assert [action["type"] for action in payload["actions"]] == [
+        "work_order_created",
+        "sms_queued",
+        "transfer_requested",
+    ]
+
+    work_orders = await client.get(
+        f"/api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/work-orders"
+    )
+    assert work_orders.status_code == 200
+    assert len(work_orders.json()) == 1
+    assert work_orders.json()[0]["priority"] == "emergency"
+
+
+async def test_missing_conversation_returns_404(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
+    response = await client.post(
+        "/api/v1/conversations/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/turns",
+        json={"text": "What are the pool hours?"},
+    )
+
+    assert response.status_code == 404
+

**Add: `C:\Users\OMEN\Desktop\Voice Agent\README.md`**

```diff
+# HOA Voice Agent
+
+Phase 1 foundation for a cascaded, streaming HOA resident-support agent.
+
+This first vertical slice deliberately separates the safety-critical workflow from the
+future voice and LLM layers. It supports:
+
+- one fake community and resident;
+- FAQ answers;
+- maintenance intake;
+- typed, deterministic emergency decisions;
+- persistent internal work orders;
+- simulated SMS confirmations;
+- simulated transfers to an on-call manager; and
+- a browser speech simulator for workflow testing.
+
+The current rule-based incident extractor is a temporary stand-in for schema-constrained
+LLM extraction. The LLM will be allowed to produce incident facts, but it will never decide
+emergency priority or routing.
+
+## Run locally
+
+Python 3.12 or 3.13 is supported.
+
+```powershell
+py -m venv .venv
+.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
+python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"
+uvicorn hoa_voice_agent.api:app --reload
+```
+
+Open:
+
+- Browser simulator: <http://localhost:8000/demo>
+- OpenAPI: <http://localhost:8000/docs>
+- Health: <http://localhost:8000/health>
+
+The known fake resident is `+15550101111`. The API uses a local SQLite database unless
+`DATABASE_URL` is set.
+
+## Run with PostgreSQL and Redis
+
+```powershell
+docker compose up --build
+```
+
+This starts:
+
+- API: `localhost:8000`
+- PostgreSQL: `localhost:5432`
+- Redis: `localhost:6379`
+
+Redis is provisioned as the low-latency state/cache boundary but is not yet used by the
+Phase 1 conversation service.
+
+## Exercise the API
+
+Start a conversation:
+
+```powershell
+$call = Invoke-RestMethod `
+  -Method Post `
+  -Uri http://localhost:8000/api/v1/conversations `
+  -ContentType application/json `
+  -Body '{"caller_phone":"+15550101111"}'
+```
+
+Report active flooding:
+
+```powershell
+Invoke-RestMethod `
+  -Method Post `
+  -Uri "http://localhost:8000/api/v1/conversations/$($call.conversation_id)/turns" `
+  -ContentType application/json `
+  -Body '{"text":"Water is leaking from the ceiling in Building A hallway."}'
+```
+
+## Test
+
+```powershell
+pytest
+ruff check .
+```
+
+## Architecture boundary
+
+```text
+Browser simulator / future LiveKit transport
+                    |
+             conversation service
+              /             \
+ temporary fact extractor   FAQ lookup
+              |
+ deterministic emergency policy
+              |
+ work-order + SMS + transfer adapters
+              |
+ PostgreSQL / future Buildium, Twilio, LiveKit
+```
+
+## Next implementation slice
+
+1. Add a Pipecat runner with browser/WebRTC transport.
+2. Stream ASR text into `ConversationService.handle_turn`.
+3. Replace rule-based fact extraction with strict structured output from the selected LLM.
+4. Stream only the `say` field into TTS.
+5. Replace simulated messaging and call control with Twilio and LiveKit adapters.
+6. Add Redis call locks, idempotency keys, and cached community configuration.
+
```

_**Agent (gpt-5.6-terra 2026-07-26 12:29:33Z)**_

Right now, you have a working HOA workflow backend—not yet a real phone agent.

Do this first:

```powershell
cd "C:\Users\OMEN\Desktop\Voice Agent"
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
uvicorn hoa_voice_agent.api:app --reload
```

Then open:

- [Voice workflow demo](http://localhost:8000/demo)
- [API documentation](http://localhost:8000/docs)

In the demo, try:

- “What time does the pool close?”
- “Water is leaking from the ceiling in Building A hallway.”
- “I smell gas in the lobby.”
- “The gate will not open.”

What happens now:

1. The browser converts your voice to text.
2. The backend identifies whether it is an FAQ or maintenance issue.
3. For maintenance, it creates a work order.
4. The emergency policy—not an AI model—decides urgency and whether to transfer the call.
5. SMS and transfer are simulated for now.

What we build next:

1. Replace browser speech recognition/speech playback with Pipecat streaming.
2. Add LiveKit browser/WebRTC rooms so the agent receives real audio streams.
3. Connect streaming ASR → this existing workflow backend → streaming TTS.
4. Replace fake SMS with Twilio.
5. Replace fake transfer with LiveKit SIP/on-call transfer.
6. Replace the temporary keyword extractor with a fast LLM that outputs structured incident facts only.

The key idea: we already built the “brain with safety rules.” Next we connect the ears, voice, and phone line around it.

What are we using SSL for? is it important?


---

_**Agent (gpt-5.6-terra 2026-07-26 13:11:55Z)**_

SSL/TLS encrypts the connection between your voice bot and NVIDIA’s hosted ASR/TTS servers.

It protects:

- Your resident audio sent to speech recognition.
- Text sent to TTS.
- NVIDIA API-key authentication.
- Responses/audio returned from NVIDIA.

Yes, it is important for the hosted NVIDIA endpoint, so our code keeps it on automatically for:

```text
grpc.nvcf.nvidia.com:443
```

You only set `NVIDIA_USE_SSL=false` when you later run NVIDIA NIM yourself on a trusted local/private network, such as:

```text
NVIDIA_STT_SERVER=localhost:50051
NVIDIA_TTS_SERVER=localhost:50051
NVIDIA_USE_SSL=false
```

This setting is separate from browser WebRTC encryption. WebRTC uses its own encrypted media transport (DTLS/SRTP); we are not turning that off.

_**Agent (gpt-5.6-terra 2026-07-26 13:41:24Z)**_

Nice — you now have real audio flowing through the agent.

In the current version, NVIDIA helps in two places:

```text
Your voice
→ Nemotron streaming ASR
→ text
→ HOA safety/workflow code
→ response text
→ Magpie TTS
→ spoken response
```

- Nemotron ASR converts your live microphone audio into text, such as “I smell gas in the lobby.”
- Magpie TTS converts the agent’s response back into natural speech.
- Pipecat handles the real-time streaming, VAD, Smart Turn, and WebRTC connection.
- Our Python emergency policy decides what to do with the transcript: priority, work order, SMS, and transfer.

Important distinction: we are not yet using the Nemotron Nano LLM. The current “understanding” layer is still the simple deterministic FAQ/keyword extractor we built first. That is why it works safely, but it is still limited in how naturally it understands varied phrasing.

The next upgrade is to add Nemotron Nano only for structured fact extraction, for example:

```json
{
  "incident_type": "gas_smell",
  "location": "lobby",
  "resident_safe": true
}
```

Then the same deterministic policy engine makes the actual emergency decision.

_**Agent (gpt-5.6-terra 2026-07-26 14:02:07Z)**_

Yes—the best fit for the system you already built is **NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B, with reasoning disabled and streamed output**.

It is the right choice because it is designed for agent/chat use, structured output, tool calling, and instruction following, but only activates about **3.5B parameters per token**. That is a good quality/latency balance for an HOA agent. NVIDIA also documents that it defaults to reasoning mode; that is useful for hard analysis but wrong for a live phone conversation. Disable it with:

```json
"chat_template_kwargs": { "enable_thinking": false }
```

NVIDIA’s own documentation shows the model supports this mode and recommends short greedy-style output for non-reasoning use. [Nemotron 3 Nano model/API documentation](https://docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/reference/nvidia-nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b)

My ranking for this project:

| Choice | Fit | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| Nemotron 3 Nano, non-thinking + streaming | Best balance; preserves your NVIDIA STT/TTS stack and supports structured tool calls | **Use this** |
| GPT-Realtime-2 | Lowest end-to-end conversational latency if we replace the cascade with OpenAI’s speech-to-speech pipeline | Best alternative, but a larger architecture/provider change |
| Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite | Good lightweight extraction/classification option | Not my first pick for the live agent; independent reports show latency variability |
| Larger reasoning models | Better for complex back-office analysis | Too slow and unnecessary for live HOA calls |

The important correction: latency is not just “which model.” Your current implementation waits for a full LLM response before handing text to TTS. For a natural voice experience we should:

1. Disable reasoning.
2. Stream LLM tokens.
3. Start TTS as soon as the first safe sentence is complete.
4. Keep the system prompt and chat history short.
5. Keep emergency decisions in Python policy—not the LLM.

Research supports that focus: in cascaded voice agents, the wait for the LLM’s first usable sentence is often the dominant delay before speech can begin; low-latency endpointing can also cut response time substantially. [PredGen research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.15556), [streaming endpointer research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.07081)

For production, self-hosting the Nano model through NVIDIA NIM near the voice service will be more consistent than a public shared endpoint. NVIDIA’s benchmarks make clear that **TTFT**—not total tokens/second—is the key metric for a voice agent, and that prompt length, network delay, batching, and queueing all affect it. [NVIDIA latency metrics](https://docs.nvidia.com/nim/benchmarking/llm/latest/metrics.html)

If the absolute fastest, most human-like conversation is the only goal, then switch the whole voice layer to OpenAI’s speech-to-speech Realtime API. It is explicitly built for low-latency WebRTC/SIP voice conversations. But for this HOA system, I recommend keeping the safer cascaded design and making Nemotron Nano the streamed conversational brain. [OpenAI Realtime API](https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/realtime?lang=javascript)

Next, I can wire Nano into general conversation—greetings, questions, clarifications—while streaming its first sentence directly into TTS.

_**Agent (gpt-5.6-terra 2026-07-26 15:39:10Z)**_

For your current prototype: **yes, it is cost-efficient**.

- Nemotron 3 Nano is available through NVIDIA’s free prototype endpoint, and we keep responses short—maximum 80 tokens for normal conversation.
- The model is an efficient MoE design, so it is a better fit than a large reasoning model for HOA conversations. [NVIDIA model page](https://build.nvidia.com/nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b)
- Your biggest ongoing cost at scale will likely be **speech**—continuous ASR plus generated TTS audio—not the short Nemotron replies.

The caveat: free NVIDIA endpoints are good for development, demos, and initial validation, but I would not depend on them as the guaranteed production pricing/SLA. NVIDIA does not publish a simple fixed per-minute public price on the model page; production generally means either a partner endpoint or self-hosting NIM. [NVIDIA NIM offerings](https://docs.nvidia.com/nim/large-language-models/latest/about-nim-llm/nim-offerings.html)

So the practical answer is:

- Demo / early customers: very cost-efficient.
- Hundreds or thousands of voice minutes: measure actual ASR/TTS usage, then compare partner-hosted pricing against a dedicated GPU/NIM deployment.
- Do not move to a large reasoning model for live calls—it would cost more and feel slower without improving this use case much.

_**Agent (gpt-5.6-terra 2026-07-26 17:05:12Z)**_

Annotation 1

The purpose is to turn this from a convincing demo into an assistant that actually resolves resident issues.

Today, when someone reports “I’m trapped in the lift,” the app creates a work order, SMS, and transfer event only inside our fake local adapters. The resident hears the right response, but no real manager, vendor, or property system is contacted.

Production plan:

| Current demo adapter | Replace with | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Fake work-order creation | Your HOA/property-management API | Create a real ticket with resident, unit, incident, priority, and call transcript |
| Fake SMS queue | Twilio or your existing messaging platform | Send a real confirmation and status updates |
| Fake on-call transfer | LiveKit SIP/Twilio/phone provider | Connect urgent calls to the actual on-call manager |
| Hard-coded FAQ data | HOA knowledge base / management-system data | Give accurate pool hours, policies, contact details, etc. |

The safety flow stays the same:

```text
Resident reports gas / lift / flood
        ↓
Deterministic emergency policy
        ↓
Real work order + real SMS + real on-call transfer
        ↓
Audit trail for management
```

This serves three business goals: faster emergency handling, fewer calls handled manually, and a reliable record of what happened and when.

Before we integrate anything, we need the real systems you use—for example, AppFolio, Buildium, Yardi, a custom HOA portal, Twilio, or a phone provider.

_**Agent (gpt-5.6-terra 2026-07-27 02:03:09Z)**_

The `400` is from Twilio rejecting the SMS request—not an NVIDIA/voice failure.

Most likely causes for an Indian recipient are:

1. Your Twilio account is trial-only and the recipient number has not been verified (`21608`). Trial accounts can send only to verified recipient numbers. [Twilio error 21608](https://www.twilio.com/docs/api/errors/21608)

2. India is disabled in Twilio’s Messaging Geographic Permissions (`21408`). Enable India under Twilio Console → Messaging → Settings → Geo Permissions. [Twilio Geo Permissions](https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/guides/sms-geo-permissions)

3. The configured Twilio `From` number is not SMS-capable or is not allowed for that destination.

I fixed the app so an SMS failure no longer stops the workflow: it will still create the work order and continue the on-call escalation. It also now exposes Twilio’s exact error code/message in the terminal on the next attempt.

Restart the bot, retry one maintenance report, and paste the new line beginning:
